# Shop LC

> Shop LC is a live shopping platform specializing in affordable jewelry, gemstones, and home décor with interactive TV shows, auctions, and exclusive deals.

Shop LC offers customers multiple ways to shop including live streaming shows, $1 jewelry auctions, curated collections, and a mobile app experience. The platform features expert hosts, educational content about gemstones and metals, and warranty protection through their Secure Shield program.

## Key Topics

- Live shopping
- Jewelry auctions
- Gemstones and diamonds
- Sterling silver
- Moissanite
- Fine jewelry
- Affordable jewelry deals
- Live TV shopping
- Online bidding
- Fashion accessories
- Home décor
- Secure Shield warranty
- Shop LC hosts
- Mobile app
- Jewelry education

## Live Shopping & Streaming

- [Jewelry on TV Live Stream](https://www.shoplc.com/livetv): Shop LC live stream shopping for jewelry and products
- [Shop LC Live Stream](https://www.shoplc.com/c/livestreaming-2): Interactive live shows with jewelry and lifestyle deals
- [Live TV Program Guide](https://www.shoplc.com/livetv/programguidedailyview): Daily shopping show schedule with hosts and timezone selector

## Jewelry Auctions

- [Online Jewelry Auctions](https://www.shoplc.com/online-auctions): $1 jewelry auctions with bidding on fine jewelry pieces
- [Jewelry Auctions](https://www.shoplc.com/c/auctions-category-jewelry): Fine jewelry auctions with gemstone and diamond pieces
- [Ring Auctions](https://www.shoplc.com/c/auctions-category-jewelry-rings): Diamond and gold ring auctions starting at $1
- [Earrings Auction](https://www.shoplc.com/c/auctions-category-jewelry-earrings): Diamond and gemstone earring auctions with bids from $1

## Collections & Shopping

- [Select Items Collection](https://www.shoplc.com/c/select-items): Trendy jewelry and accessories collection starting from $10
- [As Seen on TV Collection](https://www.shoplc.com/c/as-seen-on-tv): As Seen on TV jewelry, accessories and home décor collection
- [Last 7 Days Aired Products](https://www.shoplc.com/c/last-7days-aired): Exclusive deals on recently aired jewelry and home goods

## Account & Mobile

- [Login](https://www.shoplc.com/wishlist): User account login, authentication and account management
- [Shop LC Mobile App](https://www.shoplc.com/mobile-app.html): Shop LC mobile app download with live shopping and order tracking

## Education & Support

- [Education Center](https://www.shoplc.com/education.html): Gemstone, metal, birthstone and beauty education guides
- [Secure Shield FAQ's](https://www.shoplc.com/secure-shield.html): Secure Shield warranty protection and jewelry repair FAQs

## Community & Content

- [Meet Our Hosts](https://www.shoplc.com/meet-the-hosts.html): Shop LC host profiles including Angie Vastano and Becky Booker
